info.title: The402Machine HTTP API
info.description: Buy temporary CATCH, WHISPER and PULSE capabilities over Lightning. Supports the native quote and polling flow, HTTP Payment Authentication with Lightning charge, and L402 compatibility. Capabilities and payment credentials are bearer secrets: keep them out of URLs, logs, analytics and shared environments.

post.summary: Create or recover one GATE payment intent
post.description: Private beta. Exact request bytes are hashed. Payment goes directly to the project's stored Lightning Address. Credits are consumed only after verified authorization.

parameters.name: X-Payment-Protocol
parameters.description: Optional Payment Authentication. No x402 compatibility claim.

402.description: Native Lightning quote or HTTP Payment Authentication challenge according to X-Payment-Protocol.

post.summary: Submit payer proof for an existing intent
post.description: Submit a direct payer preimage as JSON while authenticating the project with its bearer capability. X-Gate-Project is mandatory. Authorization: Payment credentials are also accepted by the runtime; they additionally require X-Gate-Method and X-Gate-Path and must be calculated over the exact JSON proof body bytes.

parameters.name: X-Gate-Project
parameters.description: Public gate_project_* identifier owning the intent.

parameters.name: X-Gate-Method
parameters.description: Required with Authorization: Payment. Original protected request method.

parameters.name: X-Gate-Path
parameters.description: Required with Authorization: Payment. Original canonical protected request path.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer project capability, or a Payment credential bound to this exact proof request body and the original protected request metadata.

bearerCapability.description: Use the exact owner, ingest, read or ping capability dispensed after settlement. Never commit real values.

gateProjectCapability.description: Private GATE project API capability. Keep it server-side.

WhisperReadLimit.name: X-Whisper-Read-Limit
WhisperReadLimit.description: Whole number from 1 through the selected plan allowance. Defaults to the plan maximum.

WhisperRevealAt.name: X-Whisper-Reveal-At
WhisperRevealAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 reveal time inside the purchased lifetime.

PaymentProtocol.name: X-Payment-Protocol
PaymentProtocol.description: Select `payment` for HTTP Payment Authentication with Lightning charge, or `l402` for classic L402 compatibility. Omit for the native quote and polling flow.

PaymentAuthorization.name: Authorization
PaymentAuthorization.description: On the retry only: `Payment <base64url credential>` or `L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Omit while requesting the initial challenge. Treat this value as a bearer secret and never log it.

expiresAt.description: Invoice and protocol challenge acceptance deadline.

publicStatusId.description: Independent identifier used only for the optional public status page.

heartbeatsRemaining.description: Private owner-only remaining lifetime heartbeat quota.
